title: Objects on radar and seen by airmen over Malmstrom

tellings.quote: And in the meantime, there are reports at Malmstrom Air Force Base. Objects are seen on radar. Objects are seen by airmen at the base.

plain: In 1967, objects were tracked on radar and seen by airmen at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, a base that handled nuclear missiles. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer, tells Michels about these reports, passing on what he says he learned from a man named Lewis Chase. If true, it would mean unknown objects were moving freely over a nuclear weapons base.
